`binding/form_mapping.go` holds the core reflection-based mapper: `mapFormByTag`/`mapping`/`tryToSetValue` walk struct fields and look up values by tag name (defaulting to the field name), apply `default=` fallback options, and `trySplit` splits values on the delimiter chosen by the `collection_format` tag (csv `,`, ssv space, tsv tab, pipes `|`); `binding/form.go` and `binding/query.go` feed form/post-form and query values into that mapper, while `binding/uri.go` and `binding/header.go` reuse it with the `uri` and `header` tags for mapURI/header sources.

The mechanism lives in the `binding` package, where a shared reflection engine walks struct fields, reads the tag (`form`, `query`, `uri`, `header`), applies `default=` fallbacks and `collection_format` splitting.

`binding/form_mapping.go` is the single generic engine: `mapping`/`tryToSetValue` reflects over struct fields, resolves each field's name from the configured tag (falling back to the Go field name, with `-` ignored), parses `default=` and `parser=` options, and `setByForm`/`trySplit` convert multi-value input into slices/arrays by splitting on `collection_format` delimiters (csv `,`, ssv space, tsv tab, pipes `|`); the thin per-source files (`form.go`, `query.go`, `uri.go`, `header.go`) just supply the `map[string][]string` source and tag name to `mapFormByTag`/`mapForm`/`mapURI`/`mapHeader`.
